about: The Diary renamed Album Reviews (features/DIARY.md, 2026-10-17), on the dev app: the card's words, an open review's header, its Settings section and rows, the Compass by the old word. Every probe has an expect. One shot makes a review of a library album and deletes it again.
pass: Every shot ok. Read the snaps: the card, the review header, the Settings section, the Compass list.
run: node scripts/shots.mjs --list docs/ops/checks/album-reviews.json --noise 80   (dev app running; no other session driving it)

shots.about: Summon the card: its title, the + hint, the empty-row words.

steps.name: card
steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel__title')].find((t) => /Album Reviews|Diary/.test(t.textContent)); const add = document.querySelector('#diary-add'); return { title: h?.textContent ?? null, add: add?.dataset.hint ?? add?.getAttribute('title') ?? null, diaryWords: [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel')].filter((p) => p.querySelector('#diary-add')).map((p) => (p.innerText.match(/\bDiary\b/g) || []).length)[0] ?? null }; })())

expect.title: Album Reviews
expect.add: Starts a new review or makes a new folder

shots.about: Review This Album's path (requestDiaryAlbum) on a library album: the header reads Review: <album>; Back reads Album Reviews. The review made here is deleted at the end.

steps.eval: (async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const before = (await inv('diary_list')).map((s) => s.id); window.__reviewsBefore = before; const page = await inv('library_tracks', { offset: 0, limit: 200 }); const tracks = (Array.isArray(page) ? page : page.tracks ?? page.items ?? []).filter((t) => t.albumName); const name = tracks[0].albumName; const songs = tracks.filter((t) => t.albumName === name); window.__reviewsAlbum = name; const m = await import('/src/layout-bus.ts'); m.requestDiaryAlbum({ album: { title: name, artistName: songs[0].albumArtistName ?? songs[0].artistName, artwork: songs[0].artwork, catalogId: songs[0].albumCatalogId, libraryId: songs[0].albumLibraryId }, tracks: () => songs }); })()

steps.name: header
steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const p = document.querySelector('#diary-add')?.closest('.panel'); const t = p?.querySelector('.panel__title')?.textContent ?? null; return { header: t, matches: t === 'Review: ' + window.__reviewsAlbum, done: p?.querySelector('#diary-done')?.getAttribute('title') ?? p?.querySelector('#diary-done')?.dataset.hint ?? null }; })())

steps.eval: (async () => { const inv = window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke; const made = (await inv('diary_list')).map((s) => s.id).filter((id) => !window.__reviewsBefore.includes(id)); for (const id of made) await inv('diary_delete', { id }); window.__reviewsMade = made.length; })()

shots.about: Settings › Album Reviews: the section title, Grow on open's choices, the agent row's words.

steps.name: section
steps.probe: JSON.stringify((() => { const txt = document.body.innerText; return { section: /Album Reviews/i.test(txt), newReviews: /New reviews/.test(txt), everyReview: /Every review/.test(txt), oldChoice: /New entries|Every entry/.test(txt) }; })())

shots.about: Ctrl+Space, the old word "diary" (set by script): the card is found as Album Reviews.

steps.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('.compass__input'); i.value = 'diary'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()
